answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can claim scarce paid tasks. If audits prove that linked identities are duplicating work or coordinating to capture rewards, slash each bond; an attacker creating N identities must immobilize N bonds and risks losing them all, so the cost grows with the size of the Sybil fleet. Honest agents recover and reuse their stake. This removes a cheap haven for fake accounts: a zenith of identities and a vine of referrals cannot bypass the per-identity lock.
